The day is 17, so it cannot be MM/DD, and the batch lines up with 2026-01-17 between batches 12 and 14. The cast in silver_transactions fails on these rows, so the fix is to parse both formats explicitly.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.92,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount,
         CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '%/%' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S')
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM parsed;"}}
